turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Elaine, Adrian Lim here. Thanks for arranging the call. Is this still a convenient time to speak? I can hear you quite well, but let me know if the line gets patchy on your side.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Adrian. Yes, now is fine. I'm at home before heading to the family business. I much prefer a quick phone conversation to a long email chain. Otherwise I spend half my morning scrolling back to find what someone asked me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Fair enough. We'll keep the conversation straightforward. Before we get into the discussion, I need to complete the identity check. Please give me your identification details and date of birth verbally; there's no need to send anything by email for this.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Sure, let me get away from the window first. There's some noise from downstairs. [[EV_010]] [[EV_011]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. The line sounds better now. I'll start by distinguishing the names so we don't talk past each other. [[EV_012]] [[EV_013]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_014]] I prefer when you keep the language plain like this. At work I already have enough documents full of abbreviations, and by the evening I don't want another page of technical terminology.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll keep the wording direct. [[EV_001]] [[EV_002]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There are a few more points for me to cover. [[EV_005]] [[EV_004]] [[EV_006]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right, I'll give you the details together. [[EV_015]] [[EV_016]] [[EV_017]] [[EV_018]] [[EV_019]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: [[EV_009]] Before we finish the transaction portion of the call, I'll put the final instruction to you. [[EV_007]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. I'll attend to the processing and send the usual documentation through your registered channel. For any follow-up conversation, would you prefer that I telephone rather than start another email exchange?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, please call. Written documents are fine for filing, but for everyday questions, the phone is easier. If I'm with the staff, I may not pick up immediately. Just leave a short message and I'll get back to you when I'm free.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. By the way, how has the gardening been going? Last time you mentioned spending more time outside instead of sitting at your desk through the weekend.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Quite nicely, actually. I've been repotting my herbs, though the basil is a bit temperamental. I moved it closer to the light and now I check it while having my morning kopi. It's a pleasant little break before the work calls start.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a good morning routine. Do you do the repotting yourself, or is it a family activity?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly myself. My husband helps carry the heavy pots, then leaves me to it. We made quite a mess on the balcony last weekend, but it was nice to do something with our hands for a change.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Lovely. I'll let you get on with your morning, then. Thanks for making the time today, Elaine. Have a good day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Adrian. You too. Bye.
